entries.name: triune entity roles
entries.behavior: Execution is defined around entity, relation/controller, subject/view and object/model roles.
entries.decision: preserve semantic roles over canonical RelationEntity links instead of reducing all execution to subject=unit expressions

entries.name: current execution context roles
entries.behavior: vm_ctx exposes current ent, rel, sub and obj identities/values.
entries.decision: provide frontend-neutral canonical context access relations

entries.name: parent execution context traversal
entries.behavior: Nested contexts expose parent levels through $, $$, $$$ and $$$$ forms; the implementation hard-codes four textual depths.
entries.decision: preserve unbounded compositional parent traversal; drop hard-coded textual depth as implementation artifact

entries.name: context pronoun syntax
entries.behavior: $ent/$rel/$sub/$obj and repeated-$ prefixes select context roles before further path traversal.
entries.decision: compile textual pronouns to canonical reference expressions; no runtime string dispatch

entries.name: named/absolute entity addressing
entries.behavior: A reference can begin from a named entity in the VM model and traverse nested members.
entries.decision: compile names and structural traversal into canonical reference algebra; name resolution policy stays outside Executor

entries.name: lazy named entity retrieval
entries.behavior: Missing named entities may be fetched through database_api during reference resolution.
entries.decision: do not hide external lookup inside pure resolve; expose it through capability/effect policy

entries.name: lvalue path creation
entries.behavior: Write-oriented reference traversal may create missing JSON object/array members through operator[].
entries.decision: split observational resolve/find from explicit write/realize semantics

entries.name: array/lambda-vector sequential execution
entries.behavior: JSON arrays used as executable structures are evaluated in order in the current/nested context.
entries.decision: preserve ordered sequence semantics using canonical link lists; JSON array is only frontend syntax

entries.name: object/lambda-structure parallel projection
entries.behavior: Independent JSON object members are intended/executed with parallel execution policies in parts of the old interpreter.
entries.decision: first define deterministic projection and effect ordering; only later enable parallel scheduling for proven-pure operations

entries.name: foreach object
entries.behavior: foreachobj executes the subject program for every object-array item using child contexts and ordered results.
entries.decision: model as canonical map/foreach over ordered link lists with deterministic fail-fast behavior

entries.name: foreach subject
entries.behavior: foreachsub executes the object program for every subject-array item using child contexts.
entries.decision: preserve only after triune subject/object contract is fixed; express through canonical iteration semantics

entries.name: conditional execution
entries.behavior: if/then/else relations select and execute one branch based on relation/object Boolean state.
entries.decision: retain AVM link-native if as baseline and add differential cases after value/context contracts stabilize

entries.name: while execution
entries.behavior: while repeatedly executes a relation-controlled body while the condition remains true.
entries.decision: defer implementation until sequence/context/effect ordering is explicit, but retain as semantic compatibility target

entries.name: typed switch
entries.behavior: switch/bool, switch/number and switch/string select a branch from a JSON object and execute it in the parent context.
entries.decision: preserve selection semantics, replace JSON object/string keys by canonical value/key relations after value denotation exists

entries.name: language-level throw/catch
entries.behavior: throw emits a JSON value; catch executes object in parent context, captures JSON exception into relation state, then executes subject handler.
entries.decision: separate deterministic semantic failure classes from host exceptions; decide explicit program-level error values after value contract

entries.name: copy/view
entries.behavior: = copies object into subject; view executes object model in an outer context to project a view.
entries.decision: identity/copy is pure value semantics; view depends on the triune projection contract and must not use mutable host references

entries.name: numeric arithmetic
entries.behavior: base vocabulary registers +, -, *, :, pow, sqrt and sum over JSON numeric values.
entries.decision: introduce canonical numeric denotation first, then port a minimal pure arithmetic subset

entries.name: equality/comparison/boolean operators
entries.behavior: ==, !=, <, >, && and XOR operate on JSON values with type-dependent rules.
entries.decision: keep Boolean baseline; specify structural/value equality and ordering per canonical denotation instead of inheriting nlohmann::json behavior

entries.name: collection operations
entries.behavior: size, where, union and sequence/integer operate over JSON arrays/objects.
entries.decision: map only semantics that remain meaningful over canonical ordered lists/structural links; JSON object behavior is not automatically normative

entries.name: get/set/erase JSON container mutation
entries.behavior: get/set/erase directly read or mutate JSON arrays/objects and can create members on null containers.
entries.decision: do not port container mutation literally; replace needed behavior by reference resolve plus explicit immutable projection/materialization semantics

entries.name: string conversion and operations
entries.behavior: string/=, string/+=, find, split and join operate on JSON strings and arrays.
entries.decision: defer concrete operators until canonical byte/text denotation is selected; serialization format must not define semantic identity implicitly

entries.name: JSON type predicates and constructors
entries.behavior: is_array/is_object/is_string/is_number/... and json/array/object/null expose nlohmann::json's runtime type universe.
entries.decision: do not reproduce JSON type tags in core; add only structural/value shape predicates justified by canonical denotation

entries.name: print
entries.behavior: print writes JSON rendering directly to stdout.
entries.decision: treat host output as an explicit effect or frontend rendering concern, never as pure VM semantics

entries.name: tag/xml/html generation
entries.behavior: tag/xml/html combine JSON object attributes, nested execution and string rendering.
entries.decision: defer until canonical text and projection semantics exist; keep markup syntax outside core

entries.name: sleep and steady clock
entries.behavior: sleep/ms blocks the host thread; steady_clock relations expose wall/process monotonic time values.
entries.decision: require explicit clock/sleep capability and deterministic fake clock in tests

entries.name: filesystem vocabulary
entries.behavior: filesystem operations are registered as external vocabulary relations over host files/paths.
entries.decision: port only through explicit filesystem capability after canonical request/result values exist

entries.name: HTTP vocabulary
entries.behavior: HTTP client/server integration exposes network effects through vocabulary modules.
entries.decision: defer actual networking; define deterministic capability contract and fake provider first

entries.name: dynamic vocabulary loading
entries.behavior: native dictionaries are loaded dynamically and register binary views through import_relations_model_to.
entries.decision: preserve extensibility through canonical relation identities plus explicit native capability/plugin registration; dynamic symbol names are not semantic identities

entries.name: JSON container mutexes
entries.behavior: object/array/null reference mutation uses dedicated std::mutex instances for the mutable JSON representation.
entries.decision: do not port; concurrency belongs to LinkStore/backend/scheduler contracts

entries.name: JSON as program/value/context universe
entries.behavior: nlohmann::json simultaneously stores VM model, executable structures, values and mutable execution state.
entries.decision: keep JSON exclusively as compatibility frontend/projection; canonical runtime remains LinkId-only

corpus_candidates.notes: Exercises $ent/$sub/$obj/$rel and parent depths through $$$$; should be normalized into smaller golden cases before AVM implementation.
Separates pure named lookup from add_entity/materializing behavior.
AVM already has Boolean/if behavior; build a frozen jsonRVM fixture to establish differential semantics rather than source-shape equality.
Use a small deterministic array and context-dependent body; avoid effects.
Freeze simple integer cases after AVM canonical integer denotation is decided.
Capture deterministic semantic failure class; do not require raw JSON exception text parity.
